title: Show HN: Calcurio
summary: Proof of concept for one of those "a calculator for everything" sites, but with custom a multistep calculator builder, graph plotting, and a somewhat hacky algorithm for "enter any 2 of 3" type calculators. I started working on this on a whim after noticing the lack of any fast easy way to do a general ballpark inrush transient simulation. It's also installable as a PWA, and it supports adding and editing custom values in the reference tables. Still very much alpha, I think the capacitor DC bias model and the inrush current simulations may need some work to improve the accuracy. The data tables all need to be double checked, and there's some fairly obvious features that aren't there yet. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50673473 Points: 3 # Comments: 2

title: Show HN: Plain-Auth an open-source authentication library for Go
summary: Hey everyone, I've always loved the simplicity of Go, but the only thing keeping me from switching all of my backends to Go is really one package, and one package only, which is Better-Auth. It's just so easy to use: simple plugin, and start working. It's got everything I need: organizations, teams, billing, social auth, everything. I tried to scour GitHub and the open source community for anything remotely close to it in Go, and I honestly couldn't find anything that was worth it, so I just decided to make it myself. It's an open-source Go package. It is not 100% feature parity with Better-Auth yet, but it's getting there. Would love some feedback. For anyone to try it out, it works with pretty much all of those routers: Chi, Echo, Fiber, Mux and more. Any feedback is greatly appreciated. Oh, and it's also my very first open source repo, so I'm learning as I go. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50673212 Points: 4 # Comments: 0
